title: Restaurant-Style Butter Chicken
description: A rich, silky, full-flavoured classic — ready in just 40 minutes.

method.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken cubes and cook for 5-6 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan (or a large saucepan), heat the remaining 1 tbsp oil and butter over medium heat. Add onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add ginger, garlic, and bay leaves. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in cumin, garam masala, and red chilli powder. Cook for 30 seconds to release the aromas.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until it darkens slightly.
Pour in the cream, yogurt, and milk. Stir well and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Add the cooked chicken and any collected juices back into the sauce. Stir through.
Add ground fenugreek and ground cashews (if using). Stir well and simmer for another 3-4 minutes.
Squeeze in the lemon juice, stir, and taste. Adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
Remove from heat. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with naan or basmati rice.

notes.title: Chicken Choice
notes.content: Chicken thighs work best for this recipe as they stay tender and juicy. Breast meat can dry out if overcooked.

notes.title: Extra Richness
notes.content: For an even richer sauce, add an extra tablespoon of butter at the end and swirl through just before serving.

notes.title: Recipe Origin
notes.content: This recipe is adapted from traditional Indian butter chicken recipes with home-cook friendly adjustments.
